main.summary: Azure Blob Storage block-size and block-count limits used by tenant transfer publication.

field.name: MaximumBlockSizeBytes
field.summary: Maximum number of bytes allowed in one storage block.

field.name: MaximumBlockCount
field.summary: Maximum number of committed blocks allowed in a blob.

method.name: CountBlocks
method.summary: Count the destination blocks needed for a nonempty logical range.
method.param: Length of the range in bytes.
Maximum size of each destination block in bytes.
method.returns: The number of destination blocks needed to cover the range.
method.exception: Thrown when either length or maximum block size is not positive.

method.name: ValidateBudget
method.summary: Validate that requested destination blocks fit within the publication budget.
method.param: Transfer session identifier associated with a budget failure.
method.exception: Thrown when either block count is negative.
Thrown when the current or combined count exceeds the maximum.
